freeze_policy.tip_tilt: retained in every residual and discrepancy
freeze_policy.output_scale: derived from candidate E matrix and stored word width; never fitted

candidate_hardware.reference_rule: exact thresholded integer-frame quotient rounded once to nearest Q18

confirmation.pairing: factor-local pair only; shared-minimum Poisson plus shared Gaussian read noise
confirmation.independent_unit: wavefront for mixed ensembles; Monte Carlo replicate for flat

original_working_criterion.status: preserved as original project criterion; not redefined as a journal requirement

claim_specification.optical_accuracy: mean aperture-weighted piston-removed ground-truth residual with 95% Student-t CI across 20 independent wavefronts
claim_specification.numerical_sensitivity: observed paired factor-8/factor-9 changes; adjacent-pair sensitivity, not a rigorous continuum-error bound
claim_specification.noisy_expected_change: independent-batch Gram-weighted cross-product estimator of squared expected reconstructed-wavefront change
claim_specification.arithmetic_discrepancy: candidate fixed-minus-original-floating reconstruction on identical detector integers
